All persons stand for the presiding arbitrator.","sfx_cue":"wooden staff strikes floor, chairs scrape"},{"speaker":"naina","text":"Sir, before you begin, I require the previous case number.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"You require it? On your first morning itself? Please sit, Naina. Learn the room before correcting it.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"naina","text":"I am not correcting the room, sir. The register begins with today's entry. I cannot find the earlier numbers.","sfx_cue":"register pages flutter"},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"And yet the hearing has begun. Meera, kindly state what you want.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"Possession of my father's twelve-acre orchard, sir. Harish has the keys, the crop account and the north gate.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"harish","text":"I have maintained that orchard for eleven years. She came after our father died and demanded everything.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"Because he left it to me, bhai. You know that.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"harish","text":"I know what is lawful. I will obey a lawful order, even if it goes against me.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"naina","text":"Sir, that is precisely why the case number matters. A competent forum must maintain continuity of proceedings.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"Staff, did anyone ask for a lecture on competent forums?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"pooja","text":"No, sir.","sfx_cue":"typewriter carriage clicks"},{"speaker":"salim","text":"No, presiding sir. The recording is running.","sfx_cue":"tape recorder reels turning"},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"Meera? Did you ask my new clerk for a lecture?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"No, sir. I only want my orchard.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"Harish? Perhaps you requested a speech about registers.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"harish","text":"No, sir. I came for judgment.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"There, Naina. Four people understood the purpose of a hearing. Only the clerk is confused.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"VOICE FROM STAFF","text":"Maybe she requires a register to remember where she is.","sfx_cue":"staff laughter"},{"speaker":"naina","text":"Sir, I... I only asked because the first page says the register opened five years ago.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"Correct. And a qualified clerk would infer that earlier records have been archived.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"naina","text":"Then kindly give me the archive reference. I will enter it beside today's case.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"You have been here for twenty-three minutes, and already you are delaying citizens who have waited months.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"Madam, please. Let him hear us first. Small small office matters can happen later.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"harish","text":"A court should not be made to wait for its clerk.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"naina","text":"Yes. I understand.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"No, you do not. Salim, remove her chair.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"salim","text":"Sir, the chair is fixed under the record desk.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"Then use both hands. Kindly do the needful.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"salim","text":"Naina madam, thoda side, please.","sfx_cue":"chair legs drag across stone"},{"speaker":"naina","text":"Sir, where should I record the evidence?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"Standing beside Salim. Perhaps discomfort will improve your concentration.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"VOICE FROM STAFF","text":"Now she is looking like an usher only.","sfx_cue":"scattered laughter"},{"speaker":"salim","text":"Enough. The recording is catching everything.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"Let it catch. Transparency is the dignity of this tribunal.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"naina","text":"Yes, sir.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"Write. Case one. The claimant seeks exclusive possession of twelve acres formerly held by her late father.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"naina","text":"Case one of which year, sir?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"Naina.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"naina","text":"I need the year for the index.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"Write the current year. Do not convert ignorance into procedure.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"pooja","text":"I have already typed the heading, sir.","sfx_cue":"typewriter keys rattle"},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"Excellent. One employee arrived prepared.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"Sir, my father's memorandum names me. Harish took the original after the funeral.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"harish","text":"For safekeeping. Not theft.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"You will both submit your papers tomorrow. Until then, Harish will not disturb Meera's present access.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"harish","text":"If that is the court's direction, I will obey.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"Thank you, sir.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"Hearing adjourned. Salim, clear the room. Naina stays.","sfx_cue":"wooden staff strikes desk"},{"speaker":"salim","text":"All claimants outside. Take your papers. Slowly, slowly.","sfx_cue":"footsteps and murmuring recede"},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"Your application said you had three years of record-room experience.","sfx_cue":"door closes"},{"speaker":"naina","text":"Three years and eight months, sir. Civil typing, indexing and certified-copy preparation.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"Yet you challenged the bench before claimants, staff and an active recording machine.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"naina","text":"I asked for a number. A missing number can invalidate every reference after it.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"This is not the typing shop that dismissed you. Here, discipline may still compensate for qualification.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"naina","text":"That shop dismissed me without checking the original dictation.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"Everyone dismissed from somewhere has an original dictation. Do one thing. Bring the master register from my cupboard.","sfx_cue":"keys jingle"},{"speaker":"naina","text":"Which key, sir?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"The brass one. And Naina... if you open a cupboard, close it exactly as you found it.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"naina","text":"Yes, sir.","sfx_cue":"cupboard lock turns"},{"speaker":"naina","text":"This is the master register?","sfx_cue":"heavy ledger lands on desk"},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"It says so on the cover, does it not.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"naina","text":"Five years of tribunal matters should fill several volumes.","sfx_cue":"thick pages turn rapidly"},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"Find today's case and prepare the daily abstract.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"naina","text":"Sir... there are no earlier entries.","sfx_cue":"single page turns"},{"speaker":"naina","text":"The tribunal's supposedly five-year-old master register is blank, except for the case I entered this morning.","sfx_cue":""}]},{"ep":2,"title":"Three Hundred and Twenty-Six Cases","lines":[{"speaker":"devraj","text":"Close that register, Naina. Now.","sfx_cue":"cupboard door slams, ledger pages snap shut"},{"speaker":"naina","text":"Not until you explain why five years of judicial records are missing.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"Judicial records are not missing. Their index has not been migrated.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"naina","text":"Migrated from where? There is no archive reference, disposal list or old volume.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"You wanted permanent work, no? This is the work.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"naina","text":"Permanent work does not mean inventing records.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"Careful. Nobody has asked you to invent anything.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"naina","text":"Then show me one earlier case file.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"Pooja, bring the numbering sheet.","sfx_cue":"desk drawer opens"},{"speaker":"pooja","text":"Sir... that sheet is only rough planning.","sfx_cue":"paper rustles"},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"Today it becomes an administrative index.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"naina","text":"There are three hundred and twenty-six numbers on this page.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"Correct. Enter them before the case you recorded this morning.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"naina","text":"With what names? What filing dates? What orders?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"Only case number, year and status. Mark each one transferred to archive.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"naina","text":"An archive that does not exist.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"An archive that is presently unavailable. Use accurate language in a legal office.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"salim","text":"Sir, should I stop the recording? The hearing is over.","sfx_cue":"tape reels turning"},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"Yes. Private administrative work need not consume tape.","sfx_cue":"recorder switch clicks"},{"speaker":"salim","text":"Stopped, sir.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"Now, Naina. Kindly begin with case one of the first year.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"naina","text":"I will not certify three hundred and twenty-six nonexistent cases.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"Certify? No. You are merely preparing an index from data supplied by your superior.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"naina","text":"There is no data. There are only numbers.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"Numbers are the spine of a record. You said that before the full staff, did you not.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"naina","text":"I said continuity requires genuine numbers.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"And I am giving you continuity. Three hundred and twenty-six entries of it.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"pooja","text":"Naina, do it in pencil first. If sir changes the sequence, ink will become a headache.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"naina","text":"You knew the register was blank?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"pooja","text":"I knew sir kept it locked. That is all I knew.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"Pooja understands the limits of her designation. That is why she still has a chair.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"naina","text":"My employment declaration says record clerk, not author of past proceedings.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"It also says you accept responsibility for accurate preparation and maintenance of tribunal records.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"naina","text":"Accurate preparation. This is false preparation.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"That is an accusation. Accusations require evidence, qualifications and an appropriate forum. You presently have none of the three.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"naina","text":"If any authority inspects this register—","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"They will see your handwriting. So I suggest you make it neat.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"salim","text":"Sir, perhaps we can say the old index was water-damaged. Water happens in every office.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"Thank you, Salim. Do not improve documents unless instructed.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"salim","text":"Yes, sir. I was only... achha, I will lock the front door.","sfx_cue":"door bolt slides"},{"speaker":"naina","text":"You are keeping me here after closing?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"You delayed the morning hearing. You will restore that time today only.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"naina","text":"Three hundred and twenty-six entries will take hours.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"Then conversation is expensive. Begin.","sfx_cue":"fountain pen uncaps"},{"speaker":"naina","text":"Case one. First year. Transferred to archive.","sfx_cue":"pen scratches on paper"},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"Good.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"naina","text":"Case two. First year. Transferred to archive.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"pooja","text":"Leave six lines after every fifty cases. It looks more natural if the years do not finish evenly.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"naina","text":"More natural? Pooja, how many times have you done this?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"pooja","text":"I type what comes on my desk. I don't... I don't ask where it lived before that.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"A sensible employee does not interrogate paper.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"naina","text":"Paper does not go to prison. People do.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"An excellent reason to follow written instructions from a superior.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"naina","text":"Give me that instruction in writing.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"Certainly. Pooja, note: clerk directed to update pending migration work as part of routine duties.","sfx_cue":"typewriter keys begin"},{"speaker":"naina","text":"No. Write that the files were not produced for verification.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"Pooja will type my instruction, not your anxiety.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"pooja","text":"Sir, tomorrow's orchard order is also pending.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"Prepare it now. Exclusive possession to Meera, subject to document verification.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"naina","text":"Their evidence has not been submitted yet.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"And therefore the order remains subject to verification. Legal language exists to solve these small small difficulties.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"pooja","text":"Meera's name in the heading, Harish as respondent?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"Yes. Twelve-acre orchard. Effective immediately.","sfx_cue":"typewriter strikes rapidly"},{"speaker":"naina","text":"You are deciding tomorrow's hearing tonight.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"I am reducing administrative delay. Continue your index.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"NARRATOR","text":"Behind Pooja's desk, one carbon copy slid under the skirting board. Nobody saw it remain there.","sfx_cue":"thin paper slips across floor"},{"speaker":"naina","text":"Case one hundred and eighty-nine. Fourth year. Transferred to archive.","sfx_cue":"wall clock ticks"},{"speaker":"pooja","text":"Your hand is shaking. Drink water.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"naina","text":"My hand is writing lies in permanent ink.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"Your hand is completing probation work. The difference is attitude.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"NARRATOR","text":"Two hours later, the invented history reached the final page.","sfx_cue":"clock chimes nine times"},{"speaker":"naina","text":"Case three hundred and twenty-six. Fifth year. Transferred to archive.","sfx_cue":"pen stops scratching"},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"Then today's orchard dispute becomes case three hundred and twenty-seven. The sequence is continuous.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"naina","text":"The sequence is manufactured.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"Your opinion has been noted verbally and nowhere else.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"naina","text":"I want my employment declaration returned.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"The declaration belongs in your service file.","sfx_cue":"folder opens"},{"speaker":"naina","text":"That is not my service file.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"No. This is safer.","sfx_cue":"paper placed between ledger pages"},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"I am placing your signed employment declaration inside the false register, Naina.","sfx_cue":"heavy register closes"},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"If the police open it, they will treat the register's author as the creator of this court.","sfx_cue":""}]},{"ep":3,"title":"The Missing Letter","lines":[{"speaker":"devraj","text":"Stop typing. The word orchard is misspelled in a final order.","sfx_cue":"typewriter bell, paper ripped from carriage"},{"speaker":"pooja","text":"Sir, I can correct it in two minutes.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"You will not touch it. Naina certified the copy.","sfx_cue":"paper slapped on desk"},{"speaker":"naina","text":"I certified that it matched the office copy. I did not type this order.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"The office copy says orchad. Your certified copy says orchad. The error belongs to records.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"naina","text":"The error belongs to whoever typed it before yesterday's evidence was filed.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"pooja","text":"Naina, bas. Correct the spelling and issue a fresh copy.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"No quiet correction. Claimants are waiting. They deserve transparency.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"salim","text":"Meera and Harish are outside, sir. Shall I keep them there?","sfx_cue":"muffled corridor voices"},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"Call them in. Call the staff also. The tribunal will address this publicly.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"naina","text":"Sir, a typographical error can be corrected by memorandum. There is no need to humiliate anyone.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"An employee who fears humiliation usually knows where responsibility lies.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"salim","text":"Meera, Harish, come inside. Staff members also. Recording is starting.","sfx_cue":"door opens, several footsteps enter"},{"speaker":"meera","text":"Sir, has Harish challenged yesterday's order?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"harish","text":"I have challenged nothing. I obeyed it. I gave her the north-gate key this morning.","sfx_cue":"metal key lands on desk"},{"speaker":"meera","text":"And the crop account?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"harish","text":"That also. I said I would obey a lawful order.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"Your obedience is noted. Unfortunately, my records clerk has issued you a defective judgment.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"Defective how? Does it cancel my possession?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"The word orchard is missing one letter.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"One letter? The land is still twelve acres, no? The survey description is there?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"A judgment is not a vegetable list, Meera. Every word carries authority.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"harish","text":"Then the order I obeyed is invalid?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"I did not say invalid. I said defective because Naina failed to examine it.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"naina","text":"Sir, kindly show them the typed office copy. The same spelling appears there.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"Of course it does. Your function was to prevent that error from leaving this office.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"naina","text":"The function of certification is comparison. Both copies matched exactly.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"Listen to her. She is proud that she reproduced a mistake exactly.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"VOICE FROM STAFF","text":"Yesterday she knew more than the bench. Today she cannot spell orchard.","sfx_cue":"staff laughter"},{"speaker":"meera","text":"Madam, this paper controls my father's land. You should have checked properly.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"harish","text":"I surrendered possession because I believed this was a court order. Such mistakes damage both of us.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"naina","text":"I understand. But I did not decide or type—","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"Do not distribute your duty among others. Stand beside the bench.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"naina","text":"Sir, may I first inspect the draft history? The order was prepared before the hearing.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"That is irrelevant and untrue.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"pooja","text":"Sir, perhaps I should check the ribbon impression. It may show—","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"Pooja, your job is typing. Naina's job is records. Keep those boundaries clear.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"salim","text":"The recording is running, sir.","sfx_cue":"tape reels turning"},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"Good. Let the record reflect accountability. Naina, what is your monthly salary?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"naina","text":"Eleven thousand eight hundred rupees, sir.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"Your entire salary for this month is docked.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"naina","text":"The entire month? For one missing letter?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"For negligence, public embarrassment to the tribunal and risk caused to two claimants.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"naina","text":"My appointment declaration does not permit a full-month deduction without written inquiry.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"Your appointment declaration is presently securing the master register you prepared yesterday.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"naina","text":"You forced me to prepare that index.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"Is that your statement before Meera, Harish, the staff and this recording machine?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"naina","text":"I... I am asking for an inquiry into today's error.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"A wise correction. The salary deduction stands.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"Sir, I do not need her whole salary. I only need a proper order.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"Your generosity does you credit. Discipline is not yours to waive.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"harish","text":"If the corrected order is lawful, I will continue obeying it. But I want the original examined.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"Certainly. Where is your issued copy?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"harish","text":"In my document bag outside.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"Bring it. We will compare every line.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"harish","text":"I will return in five minutes.","sfx_cue":"door opens and closes"},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"While we wait, Naina will apologise to both affected parties from the bench.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"naina","text":"From the bench?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"Yes. The error travelled under the tribunal seal. The apology will carry equal visibility.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"naina","text":"I can apologise from here.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"You may also resign from there. The choice is entirely yours.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"salim","text":"Naina madam, the step is on your left.","sfx_cue":"slow footsteps on wooden steps"},{"speaker":"VOICE FROM STAFF","text":"Careful. Even the bench spelling must be correct today.","sfx_cue":"brief laughter"},{"speaker":"naina","text":"Meera, I apologise that the certified order issued to you contained a spelling error.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"Contained an error because of what?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"naina","text":"Because... because I did not stop its issue.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"Will my possession remain protected?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"naina","text":"The correction should not change the operative direction.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"You are not authorised to advise her. I need this appointment.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"Then use it respectfully.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"naina","text":"Harish, I apologise for causing you doubt about the tribunal's competence.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"Madam, come down. This is enough.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"It is enough when the bench says so.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"pooja","text":"Sir, I have typed the correction memorandum.","sfx_cue":"typewriter carriage returns"},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"Give it to Naina. Do not become ambitious.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"salim","text":"Someone is coming with Harish. Two persons.","sfx_cue":"quick footsteps approach in corridor"},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"Then return to your place. No claimant should see a clerk standing on the bench.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"naina","text":"Yesterday you made me stand beside the usher.
